about: Single-chip TIAs for Section 11.4 of the survey. Values read from rendered datasheet pages (datasheets/integrated_tia/); 'curve' = read from a plotted curve; 'derived' = computed here from datasheet data. i_pk_lin_A is the largest bipolar peak input current the datasheet shows as linear (about 1-3 % gain change unless stated), because the balanced pair's difference current swings both ways around zero; for a unipolar part it is half its range, centred by a DC offset current. noise_rms_A is the input-referred noise integrated over noise_bw_Hz. Only parts with at least 150 MHz of bandwidth and a linear (non-AGC) gain are plotted. Coherent-receiver TIAs (variable gain, one photodiode on each input) are taken at the gain setting at which their noise is published: i_pk_lin_A is their linear differential output swing over twice that transimpedance (Eq. (60)), capped by their largest stated input; alt_settings lists other published or bounding settings (evaluated, not plotted); i_dc_max_A is the largest I1 + I2 that their per-input DC limit allows. Records with only notes have no usable figures.

LMH32401.label: LMH32401 (2 kΩ)
LMH32401.bw_basis: Fig 6-1, 1 pF, curve (450 MHz TYP at 1 pF, p6)
LMH32401.noise_basis: Fig 6-11 (1 pF) integrated 10 kHz-150 MHz, derived; 8.6 pA/rtHz at 100 MHz, 9.2 at 150 MHz (curve); 250 nA rms TYP to 500 MHz (p6)
LMH32401.i_pk_basis: Fig 6-31 (p16, 25 C), curve: -1 % at -150 uA, -2 % at -250 uA, -8 % at -400 uA (photodiode sourcing); within 2 % to about +700 uA sinking; 'approximately 650 uA in the low-gain configuration (PD sinking)' (p21)
LMH32401.dc_handling: 600 MIN / 705 TYP uA through the TIA (gain within 3 dB, p6); ambient-light cancellation 2 MIN / 3 TYP mA, photodiode sinking only, 100-kHz corner, adds noise (p9, p23)
LMH32401.input: single-ended at 2.47 V, both current directions, optimised for sinking (p21)

LMH32404.label: LMH32404 (20 kΩ)
LMH32404.bw_basis: Fig 6-1, 1 pF, curve (350 MHz TYP, p8)
LMH32404.noise_basis: Fig 6-7 (1 pF) integrated to 150 MHz, derived; 56 nA rms TYP to 250 MHz (p8)
LMH32404.i_pk_basis: Fig 6-22 (p15), curve: -1.4 % at -45 uA, -3.1 % at -50 uA; 'approximately 65 uA' (p20)
LMH32404.dc_handling: 60 / 72 uA through the TIA (p8); ambient-light cancellation 1.8 / 2.5 mA, sinking only, 400-kHz corner (p9, p22)

LMH34400.label: LMH34400 (40 kΩ)
LMH34400.bw_basis: Fig 5-1, 1.0 pF, curve (240 MHz TYP at 1 pF, p5)
LMH34400.noise_basis: Fig 5-8 (1 pF) integrated to 150 MHz, derived; 50 nA rms TYP to 250 MHz (p5)
LMH34400.i_pk_basis: Fig 5-16 (p9), curve: -1.9 % at -8 uA and -3.5 % at -10 uA (sourcing); -2.0 % at +30 uA (sinking); 'approximately 30 uA' (p13)
LMH34400.dc_handling: 27 / 34 uA through the TIA (p5); ambient-light cancellation 2 / 3 mA, 400-kHz corner (p5, p14)

OPA857.label: OPA857 (5 kΩ)
OPA857.bw_basis: 125 MHz TYP at 1.5 pF (p6): below the 150-MHz band
OPA857.noise_basis: 25 nA rms TYP in a 135-MHz brick-wall band (p6)
OPA857.i_pk_basis: unipolar: 1.2 V of output swing = 240 uA (p15); half of it, centred by a 120-uA DC offset
OPA857.dc_handling: no DC cancellation; absolute maximum input 10 mA (p5)
OPA857.input: single-ended, current into IN only, 1.83 V (p18)

MAX40660.label: MAX40660 (25 kΩ)
MAX40660.bw_basis: toc15a (p9), 1 pF, curve (490 MHz TYP at 0.5 pF, p5)
MAX40660.noise_basis: toc17A (0.5 pF): 0.62 mV rms output to 150 MHz / 25 kOhm, derived; 2.1 pA/rtHz at 10 MHz (p5); higher at 1 pF
MAX40660.i_pk_basis: toc11 (p8), curve: within 2 % from -20 to +10 uA; centred with the OFFSET input, about +/-15 uA
MAX40660.dc_handling: 0.4 mA out of IN to 0 into IN, absolute maximum continuous (p4); manual OFFSET current input (p15)
MAX40660.input: single-ended at 0.85 V, current out of IN (APD anode side)
MAX40660.citations: 19-100541 Rev 4 (1/21) p4-p5, p8-p10, p15; analog.com lists Rev 6

MAX40662.label: MAX40662 (25 kΩ)
MAX40662.bw_basis: toc17a (p9), 1 pF, curve (420 MHz TYP at 0.5 pF, p6)
MAX40662.noise_basis: integrated output noise 0.6 mV (0.1-100 MHz) and 1.0 mV (0.1-200 MHz) at 25 kOhm (p6), interpolated in power to 150 MHz, derived
MAX40662.i_pk_basis: 'linear input current range of 40 uA' at 25 kOhm (p14); half of it, centred with the OFFSET input
MAX40662.dc_handling: 0.4 mA absolute maximum continuous (p5); OFFSET input for DC cancellation (p1)
MAX40662.input: single-ended x4 at 0.86 V, current out of IN
MAX40662.output: differential, one output for four inputs

MAX40658.label: MAX40658 (18 kΩ)
MAX40658.bw_basis: toc09 (p6), 1 pF, curve (520 MHz TYP at 0.25 pF, p3)
MAX40658.noise_basis: toc11 (0.55 pF): 29 nA rms to 150 MHz, scaled by 61/45 for 1 pF from toc12, derived; 45 nA rms in 267 MHz (p3)
MAX40658.i_pk_basis: toc04a (p5), curve: within 3 % only from -2.5 to +4.5 uA; 6 % MAX over +/-2 uA around the centre (p3)
MAX40658.input: single-ended at 0.78 V, current into IN (anode)
MAX40658.citations: 19-100082 Rev 2 (6/18) p2-p3, p5-p6, p8-p9; analog.com lists Rev 4

LTC6561.label: LTC6561 (74 kΩ)
LTC6561.bw_basis: 220 MHz at 2 pF total input capacitance (p2)
LTC6561.noise_basis: 39 nA rms (0.1-100 MHz) and 56 nA rms (0.1-200 MHz) at 2 pF (p2), interpolated in power to 150 MHz, derived
LTC6561.i_pk_basis: linear 0-30 uA, current out of the input only (p1, p10-p11); half of it, centred by an external 15-uA offset
LTC6561.dc_handling: no DC cancellation; DC from ambient light or dark current reduces the dynamic range (p10)
LTC6561.citations: Rev 0 (6/18) p1-p3, p5, p9-p11; analog.com lists Rev C

HMC799.label: HMC799 (10 kΩ)
HMC799.bw_basis: 630 MHz at 1 pF (p2); 700 MHz TYP, 600 MIN (p1)
HMC799.noise_basis: density curve at 1 pF (3.2-4.2 pA/rtHz over 10-150 MHz) integrated to 150 MHz, derived; 164 nA rms in 630 MHz (p2)
HMC799.i_pk_basis: not stated; from OP1dB 4 dBm into 50 ohm at 200 MHz (p2): 0.50 V peak / 10 kOhm, derived (1-dB compression, a looser criterion)
HMC799.dc_handling: not stated; input AC-coupled through 22 nF in the application circuit (p7)

ADA4355.label: ADA4355 (2 kΩ)
ADA4355.bw_basis: TIA bandwidth 43 MHz TYP at 2 kOhm (p3 Table 1): below the 150-MHz band
ADA4355.i_pk_basis: -80 to +800 uA at 2 kOhm (p3, p26), essentially unipolar; +/-80 uA without an offset

MATA-006801.label: MATA-006801 (2 kΩ, product page)
MATA-006801.bw_basis: 45 GHz small-signal bandwidth (product page); datasheet only on request
MATA-006801.noise_basis: 16 pA/rtHz input-referred (product page, specification table, beside the 2-kOhm gain; no conditions stated), a figure for a 45-GHz receiver; taken as white over 0-150 MHz
MATA-006801.i_pk_basis: the 700-mVppd output swing (product page) at the 2-kOhm gain: 0.7 V / (2 x 2 kOhm) = 175 uA peak, derived (Eq. (60)); the 3 mApp differential input the page states as linear needs 233 ohm or less, where no noise is stated

alt_settings.label: 1.5 kOhm, the manual-mode maximum, with the noise of 2 kOhm (an upper bound)
3 mApp with the 16 pA/rtHz of 2 kOhm (an upper bound: the two figures hold at different gains)

MATA-006801.gain_settings: 2 kOhm differential transimpedance (specification table); manual mode 65 ohm to 1.5 kOhm through an external pin; automatic mode holds 200-700 mVpp differential (product page)
MATA-006801.input: differential, one photodiode on each input
MATA-006801.status: product page; flip-chip die, 300 mW per channel

GX39220.label: GX39220 (500 Ω)
GX39220.bw_basis: Zt bandwidth 59 MIN / 65 TYP GHz with its photodiode model, 30-50 fF, 10-40 ohm, 150-300 pH (p8-p9); low-frequency cutoff 50 TYP / 200 MAX kHz (p9); behaviour with a 1-pF photodiode not specified
GX39220.noise_basis: 28 pA/rtHz TYP at Zt = 500 ohm, the average input noise at the photodiode model's current source up to f3dB (p9, note 1 on p10); 22 at 1 kOhm, 19 at 3.25 kOhm; taken as white over 0-150 MHz
GX39220.i_pk_basis: THD 1.5 % TYP at 1 GHz for 0.06-3 mAppd of input, 0-4 mA of DC and Vout < 500 mVppd (p9): at 500 ohm, 0.5 V / (2 x 500 ohm) = 500 uA peak, derived (Eq. (60)); the full 3 mAppd needs Zt <= 167 ohm, where no noise is stated; THD 2 % TYP for 500-550 mVppd
GX39220.gain_settings: differential transimpedance 50 ohm MAX at the minimum gain, 2800 MIN / 3250 TYP at the maximum gain, VGA range 30 dB MIN (p9); manual gain through VGC (p4); AGC loop 1.1 MHz TYP (p10)
GX39220.dc_handling: input DC current 4 mA MAX on each input; DC offset between the inputs -0.5 to +0.5 mA (p9, notes 3-4 on p10); absolute maximum 6 mA per photodiode (p7); hence I1 + I2 up to 8 mA
GX39220.input: differential: one photodiode on each input, INP and INN (p4); differential input current Iin = I_INP - I_INN (note 1, p10)
GX39220.output: differential CML with 50-ohm loads (p13); 550 mVppd MIN at the maximum output setting, clipped at 900 mVppd (p10)
GX39220.status: OBSOLETE: end-of-life notice PLC250030 (12 Sep 2025), last-time buy 12 Mar 2026, last shipment 12 Sep 2026, replacement GX39221-DNT, whose full datasheet is not public; die GX39220-DNT (p15)

RG8G32423.label: RG8G32423 (6 kΩ)

RG8G32423.noise_basis: 'Low noise < 18 pA/rtHz' (short-form p1), conditions not stated, taken at the maximum gain; taken as white over 0-150 MHz

RG8G32423.dc_handling: not stated in the short form
